content: Yonava Tambkona Emera Yawem Sembayangmona Osahowomanana, Lehra Kava Beswonam Av.
Yonava tambkona emerava livnamba, Sesoam himba sembayang vaomnavna os,
Yawe, yem kava ishomnav, hona indkoklava mendekliva kamba nonglaphoiva, wo noinda yem kava sahmanai. Kamba nepola velm vei, di indhanana sumbhol avm, wo yimba kamba hellei.
Doa pev men kam wanplombmera holopipahai, wo os kava wan endallam pihai. Wan kamba wohehlithi, wo ombokva mendekli kasra sena vevna, no ombokva pev ten doara deuhphoim.
Wo kava os omni, yimba doa kamba wohwolaihangai pevnaminiva. Heva os owai, os kava nengv, hengava kava si pevindava phovavta, diva mendekli temepelduvrava.
Tanam, wanplombva kamba wohehlithi, wo wan ilva kamba ningei kura, wo kamba wusprovna,

wo kava os nengvna, ata kava wan endalm nonglaphovav, di olona plalva lohv, kava di si yunalmba wohavav sahonamba. Heva os owai, yimba kana Sesoa lohv, wo pev kamba henga beswonam waivongai, wo henga mekava beswonam av.
Kava os nengvna, kamba dahav, novpa kanamba velawosa vevna, wo noinda yemba kava sahmanalm vongai, wo yimba kamba hellei. Di pevinda mendekli tempelduvra yimba kamba hellapra vev, wo kamba deuhphoi.
Monglava indhanamba yemba meis haravhueimniv, hevna tihsongomangas okolowol viv, heva os no tihva indhanamba kekalvho vewol vinvmoa.

Heva os kavpa owai, kava si yemba sembayang vemnavav tatasowanahonam, wo yemba okolavra sangalna. Memba yemba kava wohishomniva, si kava vevav, manara, doa kava yemba lihai, yengas indhanamba lopshawol vev, noinda beswonam av.
Wo doa nonamba Yaweva tambkom omnana, Yonam nongollahalm gao wan engallam beswonam.
